name: parser-fuzz
title: Fuzz boundary-heavy parsers
lesson: Parsers need tests that explore strange lengths, separators, encodings, and malformed input.
fix_goal: Add a fuzz target or boundary-focused test harness for parser inputs.
fix_steps: Identify the parser or boundary-heavy input function.
Add a fuzz target or randomized boundary test for malformed inputs.
Re-run the lab and confirm parser fuzz coverage is present.
